summary: Completed production build, backend regression, source review, and live route checks for the portfolio. Core routes, case-study rendering, résumé asset, exact Instagram URLs, contact email, responsive overflow, and mobile navigation were verified; two minor product issues remain.

ui_bugs.issue: Six visual placeholders are rendered as buttons with aria-labels such as 'Expand PORTRAIT PHOTOGRAPHY', but clicking them has no behavior or expanded state. Either implement the interaction or render them as non-interactive placeholders.

integration_issues.flow: Aari Label case study related-work link
integration_issues.issue: The Aari Label project data points its 'View related work' link to the Akirah Label Instagram URL. No Aari-specific URL was supplied, so this is misleading cross-project navigation.

action_items: Remove the misleading Aari-to-Akirah external link or replace it with a verified Aari destination.
Implement the photography placeholder expansion behavior or change the placeholder buttons to non-interactive elements.
critical_code_review_comments: Avoid presenting inert controls as expandable buttons; this creates an accessibility and interaction contract the UI does not fulfill.
Keep project external links scoped to the matching project to prevent users being sent to unrelated work.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_-prefixed status record through the existing status API during regression testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build succeeded. Verified home, all four /work/:slug routes, photography, writing, about, résumé, exact Instagram/email links, résumé PDF availability, desktop/mobile overflow, and mobile nav open/close. One automation navigation timing interruption occurred on photography, but a focused probe confirmed the route and Experiments section are present. No auth flow or mocked API applies.
rca of the issue: Photography controls are generated as button elements with aria-label='Expand ...' but have no onClick/state implementation, so the accessible action is inert. The Aari project reuses AKIRAH_INSTAGRAM in portfolioData.js, causing its related-work CTA to navigate to Akirah rather than an Aari-specific destination.
